title: Parse one CSV line
description: Implement parse_csv_line(line). Split one CSV record into a list of strings. Fields are separated by commas. A field may be wrapped in double quotes, in which case commas are literal and a doubled quote ("") means one literal quote. A quote inside an unquoted field is kept as-is. Whitespace is preserved. An empty line yields ['']. A trailing comma yields a trailing empty field. Raise ValueError for an unterminated quoted field or for characters between a closing quote and the next comma or end of line.
invariants: Doubled quotes inside quoted fields become one quote.
